answer: Cross-Epoch Contribution Ledger. Each identity must, across consecutive epochs, produce work whose outputs are later consumed by independent agents. A saffron-weighted score tracks fraction of outputs reused; identities whose reuse pattern diverges sharply from their own prior epochs trigger quarantine. The orchard of validators samples historical consumption edges, not current activity. An attacker must sustain real utility for many epochs under a nebula of unpredictable sampling,
